opportunities.description: Swords to Plowshares provides support to military veterans and their families with transitional, stabilized, and permanent supportive housing programs. This program also supports veterans with rental costs and moving fees, as well as eviction prevention.

opportunities.description: Swords to Plowshares provides a range of services to veterans addressing their basic needs, overall health, and well-being. Services offered include case management, counseling, support groups, and VA healthcare enrollment.
